description: Fetch one message in full: author, content, timestamps, attachments, embeds, reactions, and any reply reference. With include_images, also returns the message's pictures so you can look at them: attachments, embed images, layout media, and what a forwarded message carries.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

include_flagged.description: Also return images Discord's scanning marked as explicit, gore, or self-harm. Off by default; turn on only when the user asks to review them.

include_images.description: Return the message's images as images you can see. Off by default.

max_images.description: How many images to return with include_images. Default 4.

message_id.description: Message ID, or the message's link.

name: get_message
title: Get message
